name: Momentous Charge

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Requirements You're in Rushing Goat Stance.

---
You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force. You Climb, Stride, or Leap, then make a ramming horn Strike. On a success, the target of the Strike is pushed up to 10 feet directly away from you. On a critical success, the target is also Stunned 1.
